explanation: The value is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and at every D1 that follows a rewarded trial; it only rises at D1 after an unrewarded trial while the agent is on an a2 streak (it chose a2 on the previous trial and again on this one), and it is always 0 on a1 streaks. How high it gets depends on how late in the episode the trial is: about 0 before trial 40, 1-4 around trials 45-70, and 6-10 from about trial 80 on (mostly 9-10 after trial 90).
